## Description

Create YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/gov-copy/ for the Enhancement slice: 18F Plain Language guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, CDC reading-level guidance. Update _index.yaml and docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] YAML files created in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/gov-copy/ for:
  - 18F Plain Language guide (Creative Commons/public domain) — core principles, sentence length, plain language writing for government
  - Federal Plain Language Guidelines (public domain, Plain Writing Act of 2010) — federal requirements, active voice, common words
  - CDC reading-level guidance (public domain) — reading level targets, plain language health communication patterns
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id (unique, stable), prior_art (source URL), precedence, domain: gov-copy, license (public-domain or CC license as applicable)
- [ ] Summary + Detail tiers populated per entry
- [ ] Licensing confirmed: 18F (CC/public domain), FPLG (public domain), CDC (public domain) — document in license field
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all new gov-copy/ files
- [ ] ref-query returns >=1 result for 'reading level' in gov-copy domain
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new Enhancement entries
- [ ] docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml updated with: 18F Plain Language guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, CDC reading-level guidance (all public-domain)
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_gov_copy_enhancement.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: >=1 entry per source (18F, FPLG, CDC), schema-valid
- DD2: rule_id, prior_art, precedence present
- DD3: Licensing confirmed + documented in license field
- DD4: docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registers all 3 sources with provenance fields
- DD5: ref-query 'reading level' returns result
